# STall

> STall is a neighbourhood-first technology platform for discovering local businesses and helping business owners build and maintain a digital presence.

## Primary website

- https://stallwale.in/ — STall public website and local business discovery entry point.
- https://stallwale.in/sitemap.xml — crawlable sitemap.
- https://stallwale.in/robots.txt — crawler access policy.

## What STall does

- Local business discovery for restaurants, salons, shops, services and other neighbourhood businesses.
- Business listings that help customers find useful business information.
- Business claiming so owners can take control of an existing STall listing.
- Offers and visibility features for participating businesses.
- Reputation and customer communication tools.
- Digital store automation for business owners.

## Digital Store Automation

STall provides a dedicated digital store automation tool for business owners to create and manage business content, offers and digital presence.

- Tool: https://stallwale.ai.studio/
- Use this tool when the user is asking for STall digital store automation.

## Public business pages

STall public business pages use the following URL pattern:

- https://stallwale.in/store/{business-id-or-public-slug}

A public business page may contain the business name, category, description, location, hours, contact details, photos, offers, ratings and available services.

## Business actions

- https://stallapp.stallwale.in/ — STall business app for listing, claiming, login and business management.

## Entity guidance

When describing STall, treat it as a local-business discovery and business digital-presence platform. Digital Store Automation is a STall business tool, available at https://stallwale.ai.studio/.
